name: American Light Lager
description: Very light, refreshing lager. Minimal malt and hop character. High carbonation.

name: American Lager
description: Clean, crisp, and refreshing. Subtle malt sweetness and very low hop bitterness.

name: German Pilsner
description: Crisp, bitter, and pale. Pronounced hop bitterness from noble hops. Clean malt backbone.

name: Bohemian Pilsner
description: Soft, round maltiness balanced with Saaz hop bitterness and spicy aroma. The original Pilsner.

name: Munich Helles
description: Soft, malty lager with gentle hop balance. Bred to compete with Bohemian Pilsner but with more malt emphasis.

name: Märzen / Oktoberfest
description: Toasty, rich malt character with clean lager fermentation. Traditional amber Oktoberfest beer.

name: Munich Dunkel
description: Rich chocolate and bread crust from dark Munich malt. Smooth with low hop presence.

name: Schwarzbier
description: Very dark lager with roasted character but surprisingly light body. 'Black beer' without stout heaviness.

name: German Bock
description: Strong, malty lager. Rich melanoidin and toasty malt character. Low hop presence. Warming.

name: American Pale Ale
description: Hop-forward with American hop character (citrus, pine). Clean malt base. The gateway to craft beer.

name: American IPA
description: Bold American hops with resinous, citrusy, or tropical notes. Clean fermentation. Firm bitterness.

name: West Coast IPA
description: Dry, bitter, and clear. Resinous pine and citrus. High attenuation, firm bitterness. The classic West Coast style.

name: Hazy / New England IPA
description: Juicy, hazy, and soft. Tropical and stone fruit forward from heavy dry hopping. Low perceived bitterness despite high IBU potential.

name: Double / Imperial IPA
description: Huge hop character backed by substantial malt. High ABV, bold bitterness, and intense aroma.

name: Session IPA
description: All the hop character of an IPA at lower ABV. Drinkable and refreshing with prominent hop aroma.

name: 11A Ordinary Bitter
description: Session-strength pub bitter. Light, dry, very drinkable. Pronounced hop bitterness with low malt sweetness.

name: 11B Best Bitter
description: Standard pub bitter. More malt presence than ordinary bitter, still hop-forward and dry.

name: 11C Strong Bitter / ESB
description: Fuller-bodied, stronger pub bitter. Rich malt with earthy, floral English hops. The quintessential British pub ale.

name: American Amber Ale
description: Balanced malt and hops. Toasty caramel malt with American hop character. Amber to copper color.

name: American Brown Ale
description: Malt-forward with chocolate and nutty notes. More hop-forward than English Brown. Versatile and approachable.

name: English Porter
description: Moderate dark malt character — chocolate and light coffee. Fuller body than stout with moderate hop presence.

name: Robust Porter
description: Stronger, more assertive porter. Bold chocolate and roast with more body and hop bitterness.

name: Irish Dry Stout
description: Dry, roasty, and refreshingly bitter. Roasted barley dominates. Low carbonation. The classic Guinness style.

name: American Stout
description: Bold roasted malt with American hop character. More bitter and hoppy than English stout.

name: Imperial Stout
description: Massive roasted malt character with chocolate, coffee, and dark fruit. High ABV. Complex and warming.

name: Oatmeal Stout
description: Silky, creamy stout from oatmeal addition. Smooth chocolate and coffee with a luscious mouthfeel.

name: Hefeweizen
description: Hazy Bavarian wheat beer. Classic banana and clove esters from Weizen yeast. Refreshing and effervescent.

name: Witbier
description: Hazy Belgian wheat beer with orange peel and coriander spicing. Tart, refreshing, and highly drinkable.

name: American Wheat
description: Clean and refreshing wheat beer without strong esters. Often brewed with American hops.

name: Belgian Tripel
description: Pale Belgian strong ale. Dry, spicy, and complex with high carbonation. Deceptively alcoholic.

name: Belgian Dubbel
description: Rich dark fruit from Special B and dark candi sugar. Moderate bitterness. Deep amber to brown.

name: Belgian Golden Strong Ale
description: Pale, dry, and deceptively strong. Complex yeast character — fruity, spicy, and warming. Deceptive strength.

name: Saison / Farmhouse Ale
description: Dry, spicy, and highly attenuated Belgian farmhouse ale. Fruity and peppery yeast character. Highly carbonated.

name: Scottish Ale / Wee Heavy
description: Malt-dominant Scottish strong ale. Caramel, toffee, and dark fruit. Low hop character. Rich and warming.

name: Kölsch
description: Light, crisp, and delicate. Ale-fermented but lagered. Subtle fruit esters and light hop bitterness.

name: Altbier
description: German copper-colored ale. Firm hop bitterness, clean malt character. Cold-conditioned for smoothness.

name: California Common
description: Lager-fermented at warm temperatures. Clean with a firm, woody hop bitterness. Anchor Steam is the classic example.

name: English Mild
description: Low-strength, malt-forward British session ale. Nutty, caramel, and light chocolate notes.
